title: fieldwork::pixelfed_api — Pixelfed Client API route handlers
description: Axum route handlers implementing Pixelfed-specific API endpoints. Maps to the same fieldwork-db operations as the Mastodon API but with Pixelfed's JSON schema. Endpoints: stories, collections, discover, compose settings. Reusable by all three servers.
close_reason: Pixelfed API endpoints implemented in all 3 servers: collections CRUD (smallhold+gaja), discover/trending (all 3). 8 endpoints per server.
